description: This file defines the 'Scenario' interface for testing and configuring different test scenarios within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It provides static factory methods to create 'ScenarioSetup' instances with various parameters, as well as methods to access scenario properties such as its setup, group, policy, and application algorithm.

classes.name: Scenario
classes.description: An interface representing different test scenarios for the enforcers in the Eclipse Ditto testing framework.

methods.name: newScenarioSetup
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ScenarioSetup with specified policy, context, resource, permissions, and expected result.

methods.name: newScenarioSetup
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ScenarioSetup with additional expected subject IDs.

methods.name: newScenarioSetup
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ScenarioSetup with an additional algorithm function.

methods.name: newScenarioSetup
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ScenarioSetup with full JSON view and expected JSON object.

methods.name: newAuthorizationContext
methods.description: Creates a new AuthorizationContext with specified primary and secondary authorization subjects.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the simple name of the scenario class.

methods.name: getSetup
methods.description: Returns the setup configuration for the scenario.

methods.name: getScenarioGroup
methods.description: Returns the group name of the scenario.

methods.name: getPolicy
methods.description: Returns the policy associated with the scenario.

methods.name: getApplyAlgorithmFunction
methods.description: Returns the function applying the policy algorithm.
